biggest_cut: Cut the long literature survey in Section 1.1 (Bernoulli convolutions, Pisot and Erdős, Solomyak, Rapaport–Varjú, Feng–Feng, Baker/Bárány–Käenmäki) and the narrated three-step overview down to a few sentences, because none of it is used in the argument; smaller cuts are the restatement of (8) as (34), the repeated definition of c_ℓ in Proposition 9, and the one-line Corollaries 15–16.
